zh.title: 澳洲皇家空軍P-8A Poseidon部署日本參加Keen Sword演習
zh.summary: 澳洲皇家空軍P-8A Poseidon部署日本，參加約260架航空器參與的演習
body: 澳洲皇家空軍（RAAF）一架P-8A Poseidon海上巡邏機已部署至日本，參加Keen Sword演習。AeroTime報導，演習於2026年10月19日至29日舉行，約有260架航空器參與。
澳洲國防部於2026年10月20日公佈，近300名澳洲國防軍人員已部署至日本參加演習。演習目標是提升戰備程度，以及盟軍共同運作的能力。

en.title: RAAF P-8A Poseidon deploys to Japan for Keen Sword exercise
en.summary: The RAAF deployed a P-8A Poseidon to Japan for Keen Sword, involving about 260 aircraft.
body: A Royal Australian Air Force (RAAF) P-8A Poseidon maritime patrol aircraft has deployed to Japan to take part in Exercise Keen Sword, AeroTime reports. The exercise is running from October 19 to 29, 2026, and involves around 260 aircraft.

Australia’s Department of Defence announced on October 20, 2026, that almost 300 Australian Defence Force (ADF) personnel had deployed to Japan for the exercise. Its stated aim is to improve readiness and the ability of allied forces to operate together.

zh.title: 波音推出Dataliner平臺 整合航空資料支援機隊決策
zh.summary: 波音推出Dataliner，整合航空資料支援機隊維護與營運決策
body: 波音於2026年10月20日宣佈推出Dataliner，將其定位為協助航空公司運用航空資料的人工智慧資料智慧平臺。波音表示，平臺把分散資料轉為連結的機隊層級資訊，以支援維護及營運決策。
Dataliner與Microsoft合作建置，採用Azure AI Foundry及Microsoft的資料解決方案。波音表示，航空公司可控制分享哪些資料，並透過應用程式、API、分析及AI功能使用波音資訊。平臺也支援波音數位服務新產品Asset Lifecycle Planning及TechOps AI Agent的開發。

en.title: Boeing introduces Dataliner platform for airline data intelligence
en.summary: Boeing introduced Dataliner, an AI-powered platform for airline data and fleet maintenance decisions.
body: Boeing announced Dataliner on October 20, 2026, describing it as a new AI-powered data intelligence platform designed to help airlines use their aviation data. Boeing says the platform connects fragmented data into fleet-wide intelligence to support maintenance and operational decisions.

Built in partnership with Microsoft, Dataliner uses Azure AI Foundry and Microsoft data solutions. Boeing says airlines control what they share and can access Boeing intelligence through applications, APIs, analytics and AI-enabled experiences. The platform also supports the development of Boeing Digital Services products, including Asset Lifecycle Planning and TechOps AI Agent.

zh.title: 漢莎航空規劃2027年開通哥倫布至法蘭克福直航
zh.summary: 漢莎航空規劃2027年5月開通哥倫布至法蘭克福每週三班直航。
body: 漢莎航空規劃自2027年5月5日起，開通美國哥倫布約翰·格倫哥倫布國際機場（CMH）至法蘭克福機場（FRA）的航班。航空公司表示，這條航線將每週營運三班，安排在週三、週五及週日。
這項航線將以波音787夢幻客機（Boeing 787 Dreamliners）執飛，並配備漢莎航空的Allegris客艙。漢莎航空公佈的航班時間為：去程於哥倫布當地時間16時20分起飛，隔日上午6時15分抵達法蘭克福；回程於法蘭克福當地時間11時15分出發，並於當日下午14時抵達哥倫布，所列時間均為當地時間。
漢莎航空、哥倫布區域機場管理局及經濟發展機構JobsOhio於10月19日公佈這條航線。報導指出，這將是哥倫布首條定期直飛歐洲的客運航線，也將成為俄亥俄州唯一的德國直飛服務。
旅客抵達法蘭克福後，可經由漢莎航空的法蘭克福樞紐轉往其他目的地。報導稱，該航線將提供經法蘭克福前往歐洲、中東、非洲及亞洲130多個目的地的轉機選項。這項新服務的航班日、起降時間及執飛機型均已公佈；航線則預定於2027年5月開始營運。

en.title: Lufthansa plans three weekly Columbus–Frankfurt flights from May 2027
en.summary: Lufthansa plans three weekly nonstop Columbus–Frankfurt flights beginning in May 2027.
body: Lufthansa plans to begin service between John Glenn Columbus International Airport (CMH) and Frankfurt Airport (FRA) on 5 May 2027. The airline plans to operate three flights per week, on Wednesdays, Fridays and Sundays. The service is scheduled to connect Columbus with Lufthansa’s Frankfurt hub.

The route is set to be flown with Boeing 787 Dreamliners fitted with the airline’s Allegris cabins. The published schedule lists a 16:20 departure from Columbus, arriving in Frankfurt at 06:15 the following morning. The return flight is scheduled to leave Frankfurt at 11:15 and arrive in Columbus at 14:00. All listed times are local.

Lufthansa, the Columbus Regional Airport Authority and economic development organisation JobsOhio announced the route on 19 October. The service is described as Columbus’s first scheduled nonstop passenger connection to Europe. It is also set to be Ohio’s only nonstop service to Germany.

Passengers arriving in Frankfurt will be able to connect through the airline’s hub. The route is described as offering onward connections through Frankfurt to more than 130 destinations across Europe, the Middle East, Africa and Asia. The announcement sets out the planned operating days, airport pair, aircraft type and schedule for the service. Lufthansa’s planned start date is 5 May 2027, with three weekly services beginning that day.
